messages:
ana (DevEx): Trying to onboard a new customer using the service-account flow. After running the CLI setup and `rwd auth create-service-account`, the first call I make returns 403 with body {"error":"billing_required"}. Workspace is w-bleu-9.

ana (DevEx): Example curl I used: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer rwd_sa_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

alisha (Support): Hmm — does the workspace show as "active" in the Console billing page? New workspaces created via SSO sometimes need an admin to accept billing TOS.

ana (DevEx): Console shows billing method added but status = "pending_activation". I thought adding a card was enough.

sam (Platform): That status rings a bell. We have a race where service-account tokens are minted before the billing activation webhook finishes. The token lacks the billing-checked claim so API returns 403.

mike (Eng): Confirmed. Repro steps: create workspace via SSO -> add card -> call token mint -> first request 403, subsequent requests succeed after billing webhook processed. Root cause is `AuthService.Mint()` not waiting for `billing.active` flag when issued by service-account flow.

ana (DevEx): Oof. Customer hit this in the wild and thought the SDK was busted. Any short-term workaround?

alisha (Support): Workaround: have the admin open Console -> Billing -> Accept terms (there's a banner) OR run `rwd workspace refresh --wait-billing` (internal CLI flag). For customers hitting this we can advise to retry after ~15s.

sam (Platform): Pushed a small guard: when minting a SA token we now include `billing_state` in the token metadata and API rejects with 409 if billing still pending (better error than 403). PR #3456.

deploy-bot: CI deploy starting for release v1.34.2 (contains platform PR #3456).

mike (Eng): Also added a tiny retry in the JS/Go SDKs when used with service accounts: 3 fast retries with exponential backoff on billing_required error. That should reduce customer pain while the deploy rolls out.

ana (DevEx): Nice. Can we get an internal note in onboarding docs to call out this edge-case and the `rwd workspace refresh --wait-billing` CLI hint? I want to update the quickstart sample.

alisha (Support): I'll add a KB article with the exact repro and the Console screenshot for the Accept TOS banner.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: v1.34.2 -> prod (hash: a1b2c3d). :white_check_mark:

ana (DevEx): Verified with the original customer. After the deploy their first call now returns a clearer error and the SDK auto-retries; they progressed to first successful call. Thanks everyone. :tada:

mike (Eng): Filed follow-up to make the CLI `init` wait for billing by default for new workspaces (ticket TKT-789).

ana (DevEx): Summary for the quickstart doc: 1) Explain SSO/new workspace billing acceptance; 2) show `rwd workspace refresh --wait-billing`; 3) note SDKs will auto-retry on billing_required until deploy fully hits.

alisha (Support): Adding KB link once published.
